missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Убийство' is the neuter nominative predicate noun. 'Жестокое' is the neuter adjective agreeing with it. A grim but natural way to characterise a crime.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Убийство' is the accusative direct object of 'расследует'; neuter nouns match the nominative. 'Это' agrees in the neuter accusative. Common in news reports.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Убийства' is in the genitive to mean witnesses of the murder, modifying 'свидетелей'. The negated 'не нашли' completes the report. Useful for legal language.

Strategic focus: Prepositional after 'в'. The phrase 'обвинить в' takes the prepositional 'убийстве' to state the charge. 'Соседа' is the genitive object of the murder. The standard accusation pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'для'. The preposition 'для' takes the genitive 'убийства' to mean a motive for it. 'Мотива не было' uses the genitive of absence. Useful for investigations.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об убийстве' uses the prepositional 'убийстве' after 'об' to mean writing about it. 'Этом' agrees in the neuter prepositional. Common in media coverage.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after 'в'. The verb 'признаться в' takes the prepositional 'убийстве' to mean confessing to it. 'Вчера' sets the time. The standard confession pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after 'несколько'. 'Несколько' governs the genitive plural 'убийств'. 'Произошло' is the impersonal verb of occurrence. Practises plural counting of events.
Strategic focus: Accusative after 'за'. 'За убийство' uses the accusative 'убийство' after 'за' to state what he was sentenced for. 'Суд' is the masculine nominative subject. A legal-outcome pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'к'. The phrase 'привести к' takes the dative 'убийству' to mark the result. 'Преступление' is the neuter nominative subject. Useful for describing consequences.
